component.name: Ring-2Zero
component.summary: Stream a Wayland desktop to any browser over WebRTC

description.p: Ring-2Zero captures a Wayland output (wlr-screencopy DMA-BUF on wlroots compositors, PipeWire on GNOME and KDE), sends only the tiles that changed, and serves the browser client from the same binary. Open the printed URL and enter the token; optional remote mouse and keyboard control.
